in_text_mentions: A localised skin infection can occur in the area around the infecting tick bite anywhere from 3 to 30 days following the tick bite [74]. The extent and duration of the inflammatory reaction varies greatly between individuals. A diagnosis of erythema migrans requires the diameter of the erythema to be more than 5 cm (Figure 2A and B (Fig. 2)) [75].

in_text_mentions: Clinical examination revealed a solitary erythematous papule with central umbilication located adjacent to the lateral malleolus. The lesion measured only a few millimeters in diameter and was soft on palpation (Figure 1). Dermoscopic examination demonstrated a central crusted umbilication surrounded by a homogeneous pink structureless area (Figure 2).
